card.name: Words after 'already' about things emerging
card.fires_on: Small words and verbs in historical or religious prose that come just before a verb of growth, spread or beginning, often after 'already' or 'were'. It marks something starting, growing or being in place.

modes.label: After already
modes.description: The word 'already' or a helper verb saying something was already underway.
modes.example: although the mystery of iniquity was<< already>> at work.

modes.label: Verb of growth or emergence
modes.description: A verb or 'to' leading into growing, emerging or spreading.
modes.example: abundant legends had already begun to<< grow>> elsewhere

modes.label: Linking word before a state
modes.description: A word like 'at', 'are' or 'is' before a state of being in progress.
modes.example: the mystery of iniquity was already<< at>> work.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses words like replacing and flourish, and promotes odd word pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before a phrase saying something was already growing, spreading or at work.
